capabilities: Summarize vault health, inbox, task flow, and note-creation activity
Track tasks with persistent TODO, DOING, and DONE states
Track projects filtered by folder and frontmatter status
Schedule daily GitHub and RSS feed archives into dated Markdown notes
Run Codex CLI deep research on desktop and save the report to the vault
extras: Desktop Obsidian is required only for the optional Codex CLI deep-research feature; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no single built-in view that combines vault health, task flow, project status, and external research feeds in one place.

relations.evidence: On desktop it starts the configured Codex CLI executable with a read-only, ephemeral command

summary: Dashboard plugin that monitors vault activity, tasks, projects, agent runs, and daily research feeds from one local control surface.
